description: This Kotlin source file defines classes, interfaces, and functions related to storing and managing device authentication tokens within an Android application, including token persistence, retrieval, normalization, and associated metadata handling.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a device authentication token entry, including token string, role, scopes, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Private serializable data class used for persisting metadata related to device authentication, such as scopes and last update time.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that interacts with SecurePrefs to persist and retrieve device authentication data, including normalization and metadata handling.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a device authentication entry by device ID and role, decoding stored token and metadata.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a device token with associated scopes and timestamp.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes stored token and metadata for given device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized key for storing the token based on device ID and role.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized key for storing metadata based on device ID and role.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Trims and lowercases the device ID for normalization.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims and lowercases the role string for normalization.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims, filters, deduplicates, and sorts the list of scope strings.
